rationale: Canonical AWS-only Agent Mode list matches all fifteen named feature regions. Azure Model Runtime does not extend Agent Mode. Base-assistant GovCloud rows do not establish universal FR-M/FR-H authorization. New Splunkbase 2.4.0 discovery requires version-specific follow-up; preserve 2.3.6 historical scope. Splunkbase now lists 2.4.0 dated November 18, but its exact region/runtime/dependency chain remains follow-up; the 2.3.6 evidence stays historical.

products: Splunk AI Assistant / ITSI / Splunk MCP Server
exclusions: No complete ITSI/SAIA/MCP combination or subagent-specific region is established.

evidence.section: Supported regions; Model Runtime feature availability and region standard; Cloud Connected compatibility; SAIA-9918; ITSI subagent
evidence.statement: Base SAIA regions are separate from AWS-only Agent Mode. Model Runtime has AWS and Azure labels and Global/Data zone routing; IL2 fixes Splunk-hosted models and excludes Agent Mode. 2.3.6 Cloud Connected documentation and SAIA-9918 exclude 2.2.0–2.3.6 and say 2.4.0 is planned; 2.1.1 fallback excludes Agent Mode. ITSI subagent-specific region rollout remains unestablished.
